items.title: Derrick Henry: Clears concussion protocol
items.text:
Henry has cleared concussion protocol and will be available in the Ravens' locker room following Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers, Giana Han of the Baltimore Banner reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Micah Parsons: Limited in practice
items.text:
Parsons (knee) practiced in a limited capacity Sunday, Rob Demovsky of ESPN reports.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Enters concussion protocol
items.text:
Coker entered the league's concussion protocol following Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Eclipses century mark in win
items.text:
Johnson rushed 23 times for 105 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 38 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
